lines.cap: Every night, for years, he went down on Google Earth, searching.

lines.cap: 1986, India. Five-year-old Saroo fell asleep on a train, and woke up alone.
lines.say: 1986, India. Five-year-old Saroo fell asleep on a train, and woke up alone.

lines.cap: The train carried him about fifteen hundred kilometres, to Kolkata. He didn't know the name of his town.
lines.say: The train carried him about fifteen hundred kilometres, to Kolkata. He didn't know the name of his town.

lines.cap: He lived on the streets, until an orphanage took him in. An Australian couple adopted him.
lines.say: He lived on the streets, until an orphanage took him in. An Australian couple adopted him.

lines.cap: Twenty years later, he started searching. Following railway lines on Google Earth, every night after work.
lines.say: Twenty years later, he started searching. Following railway lines on Google Earth, every night after work.

lines.cap: In 2011, he spotted a water tower he remembered. His hometown, Khandwa.
lines.say: In 2011, he spotted a water tower he remembered. His hometown, Khandwa.

lines.cap: He flew back, walked the streets he'd last seen as a child, and found his mother. She had never stopped hoping.
lines.say: He flew back, walked the streets he'd last seen as a child, and found his mother. She had never stopped hoping.

lines.cap: Twenty five years, found by a little boy's memory.
lines.say: Twenty five years, found by a little boy's memory.
